cases.name: Cynthia Marie "Cyndi" Cox
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Cyndi was born in Cook County, IL. She graduated from Scottsboro High School in 1981. She enjoyed gardening vegetables and flowers, and gifting all her handmade creations, such as sewing, décor, and candles. Cyndi was a very loving wife, mother, and grandmother and was willing to do anything she could for them. Her favorite hobby was spending time with her grandson."
